en: The image is a vintage postcard showing a waterfront scene with several boats and ships docked along the quay. Grand, classical-style buildings line the waterfront, with some trees and people visible along the promenade. There are also logs floating in the water in the foreground. The overall tone is sepia or black-and-white, suggesting an early 20th-century or late 19th-century period. The text 'Pori - Björneborg' appears at the bottom of the postcard.
